_meta.author: build, M29.1 (5 Oct 2026): fictional providers; failure rates from doc 31's base rates (~1% mature, 5-15% under ten flights [A/inference]); prices, slips and bumps designed

providers.note: Carrack Heavy (was Pallas Heavy, renamed M34.3: a real Pallas-1 rocket exists): the dominant reusable super-heavy launcher; most slots, the lowest price, prices to the next-best alternative; can bump third-party payloads for its own constellation in a tight quarter
Northgate: the second heavy launcher and lunar lander maker; fewer slots, frequent slips, cheaper per kg when it flies (doc 31: one flight in 2026 against a goal of 8-12 [A])
Kestrel: a reliable medium launcher, dearer per kg, small blocks only
A sovereign partner's launcher: available with that partner's strings (M31)
